top.title: Gold Falls as Investors Assess Fed Signals, Await Inflation Data
top.summary: Gold prices fell as investors digested the Fed’s policy meeting while waiting for the release of U.S. inflation data later on Thursday.

top.title: U.S. Treasury Yields Fall as Investors Digest Fed Meet, Focus Shifts to ECB
top.summary: Treasury yields dropped in Asian trade as markets digested the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision, with the focus now shifting to the European Central Bank’s meeting.

top.title: In Moving Gradually, Fed Risks Having to Play Catch-Up to Quell Inflation
top.summary: Federal Reserve officials are expected to restart rate increases in December, but the cadence of additional moves will depend on the data.

top.title: Eurozone Bond Yields Fall Ahead of ECB Decision; French OATs Outperform
top.summary: Eurozone government bond yields fell at open, tracking their U.S. peers, as markets prepare for the ECB rate decision. The 10-year French OAT outperformed.

top.title: U.S. Stocks Up, Treasury Yields Mixed After Fed Hold
top.summary: U.S. stocks rose slightly after the Federal Reserve held rates steady despite elevated inflation and left the door ajar to a rate hike in December.
